2f5bc44f785fa4ea63416ceda8f4f958cc62443e.argues_against: Primary Lung Cancer with Synchronous Lesions
2f5bc44f785fa4ea63416ceda8f4f958cc62443e.why: The finding of interval growth of the hyoid bone lesion despite a complete metabolic response of the lung mass suggests that the hyoid lesion is not a synchronous lesion of the same primary lung cancer.

ranked_facts.why: The patient's history of melanoma, treated six years earlier, is more consistent with metastatic melanoma than with primary lung cancer or other malignancies.
The substantial decrease in size and complete metabolic response of the lung mass after chemotherapy is more consistent with metastatic melanoma than with primary lung cancer or other malignancies.

ranked_facts.why: The patient's history of melanoma, treated six years earlier, is more consistent with metastatic melanoma than with a primary bone tumor or Ewing sarcoma.
